Ai._comment_AnalysisRepair: Production policy for the analysis-output repair layer (Ai:AnalysisRepair, see AnalysisRepairOptions in Services/Ai/AiOptions.cs). This block MIRRORS base appsettings.json (Enabled:true, GuardOnly:true, Mode:GlossaryThenDynamic, glossary-on for all PerType) because prod currently serves Ollama-LOCAL models via Ai:FeatureModels (gemma4:12b / qwen3.5:9b / DictaLM-3.0) - a leaky tier where the deterministic glossary guard still earns its keep. KEEP IN SYNC with Ai:FeatureModels: the model actually served in prod. Do NOT make this a no-op on the assumption a cloud tier is leak-free: a 2026-07-10 3-passage cloud sweep (google/gemma-4-31b-it via OpenRouter) leaked English into Hebrew prose at the SAME ~1/3 rate as local gemma4:12b (local leaked 'confusion', cloud leaked 'claustrophobia'; both out-of-glossary abstract nouns). No measured tier is leak-free on this task, so keep the guard ON across tiers (it is a zero-cost no-op on clean fields). CAVEAT: the deterministic glossary only cleans its ~35 curated craft terms, NOT the general-vocabulary leaks seen in the wild - a dynamic detect-and-repair replacement for the closed glossary (DynamicTermRepairService, dynamic-term-repair-design plan) EXISTS and is turned ON in prod via Mode=GlossaryThenDynamic (the span-scoped dynamic stage runs AFTER the glossary fast-path; flip Mode back to Glossary/Off to disable it, and Enabled=false remains the master off-switch). The ON default rests on the 2026-07-12 RE-MEASURE (be-c08, docs/ANALYSIS_OUTPUT_REPAIR.md section 18), which drove the REAL BookEntityProvider over a real DbContext on the shipped LOCAL gemma4:12b tier: out-of-glossary cleaning 100% (10/10), unchanged (delta 0 percentage points, 0 leaks spared) when an adversarial per-book entity set is active; legitimate-term preservation 100% (21/21) with 0 false positives; over-rewrite 0; and 0 legitimate values reaching the model, so precision here is a property of the DETERMINISTIC GATE rather than of the model tier. It SUPERSEDES the 2026-07-11 d5/d6 tables (section 17), which fed a hand-built entity set and therefore never exercised the harvest logic or the bookId threading that actually ship. KEEP THIS BLOCK IN SYNC with base appsettings.json: AnalysisRepairConfigParityTests.Mode_BaseAndProduction_AreEqual fails if the two Mode values diverge. Extension point (documented only, NOT implemented): a per-provider/per-model override on AnalysisRepairOptions is only needed if a single environment ever serves MULTIPLE tiers at once (e.g. some requests to a cloud model, others to local Ollama, in the same deployment) - see the AnalysisRepairOptions xmldoc in Services/Ai/AiOptions.cs for the full note.
